aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:862.description: For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. jobgether-jobgether:lever:20e0a967-e3e7-.title: Data Protection Lead Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:20e0a967-e3e7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Protection Lead Engineer based in India. This is a senior cybersecurity role focused on protecting sensitive enterprise data across a global technology environment. You will lead the technical strategy and architecture for a large-scale Data Loss Prevention (DLP) program. The role combines Microsoft Purview and Sentinel expertise with cloud security, automation, APIs, and emerging AI/ML techniques. You will translate complex security requirements into scalable solutions while balancing strong protection with business usability. As a technical leader, you will influence architecture decisions, resolve high-risk incidents, and improve detection and response capabilities. You will also mentor engineers and collaborate with senior stakeholders across security, privacy, infrastructure, and business teams. Own the technical strategy, architecture, roadmap, and policy design for a global DLP program using Microsoft Purview, Sentinel, or equivalent enterprise security platforms. Design and implement advanced DLP policies that effectively protect sensitive information while maintaining usability across regions and business units. Apply machine learning and AI techniques to improve data classification, reduce false positives, enhance threat detection, and strengthen data protection capabilities. Architect and oversee automated workflows and data pipelines using technologies such as Python and Azure Logic Apps to transform DLP telemetry into actionable security insights. Design, manage, and govern RESTful APIs that integrate DLP platforms with broader cybersecurity and technology ecosystems. Lead investigations into complex and high-risk data loss incidents, including remediation, root-cause analysis, and implementation of preventative measures. Develop executive-level metrics, dashboards, and reporting that provide clear visibility into data loss risks, security posture, and program maturity. Translate ambiguous business and security requirements into technical roadmaps while managing scope, feasibility, priorities, and resources. Present architecture decisions, technical strategies, and recommendations to senior leadership and cross-functional governance forums to secure alignment and approval. Drive continuous improvement across DLP tooling, processes, detection capabilities, and operating models, including adoption of emerging AI/ML security technologies. Lead technical retrospectives and process improvement initiatives, addressing systemic issues and removing recurring operational gaps. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through technical guidance, architecture and code reviews, knowledge sharing, and professional development. Collaborate with security, privacy, infrastructure, and business teams to remove cross-functional roadblocks and advance enterprise-wide data protection initiatives. Requirements: Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline. At least 5 years of professional cybersecurity experience, including 3+ years specializing in Data Loss Prevention, data governance, or closely related security domains. 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Purview and/or Microsoft Sentinel, ideally within a large enterprise environment. At least 2 years of practical experience with Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including securing and protecting data across cloud environments. Demonstrated ability to apply machine learning or artificial intelligence concepts to cybersecurity, data protection, classification, threat detection, or related use cases. Strong understanding of DLP architecture, policy development, data classification, security monitoring, incident investigation, and enterprise data protection practices. Experience designing automated workflows and integrations using Python

jobgether-jobgether:lever:7703961e-4d6e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer based in Switzerland. This is a senior-level SRE opportunity focused on solving complex reliability, infrastructure, and platform challenges in a fully remote environment. You will take ownership of high-impact projects, from solution discovery through delivery, while helping shape platform architecture and long-term reliability strategy. Your work will span Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, infrastructure as code, observability, CI/CD, and operational excellence. You will also play a key role in establishing strong SLOs, alerting, incident response, and reliability practices across engineering. AI is embedded into the way the team works, with an emphasis on building practical, reusable AI workflows that improve engineering productivity and safety. The role offers significant autonomy, technical influence, and opportunities to mentor engineers while collaborating asynchronously across a global organization.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:f8ffbb22-c21b-.title: Business Development Manager - FX/Cross Border Payments
jobgether-jobgether:lever:f8ffbb22-c21b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Development Manager - FX/Cross Border Payments based in Canada. This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially driven professional to grow new business within the international payments and foreign exchange space. You will build and manage a pipeline of corporate prospects, helping businesses address complex cross-border payment and hedging needs. The role combines consultative B2B selling, financial expertise, relationship building, and proactive business development. You will engage decision-makers ranging from business owners and directors to senior finance leaders and C-suite executives. Using modern sales tools and multiple prospecting channels, you will own opportunities through the sales cycle and into client onboarding. You’ll join a fast-paced, globally connected environment where performance, initiative, and customer value are highly valued. The position offers the opportunity to make a measurable revenue impact while developing expertise in international payments, FX, and risk management. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective corporate clients for B2B payment and foreign exchange solutions, identifying organizations with international payment, risk management, or hedging requirements. Drive new business revenue and consistently achieve agreed KPIs and targets, providing regular weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance updates. Proactively generate opportunities through cold calling, email outreach, networking events, referrals, exhibitions, partnerships, and other business development channels. Use sales and prospecting platforms such as Salesforce, Highspot, and ZoomInfo to research prospects, generate leads, manage activities, and advance opportunities. Own the sales cycle from initial prospecting and qualification through commercial negotiations and client onboarding before transitioning relationships to the account management team. Consult with prospects to understand their international payment and hedging requirements and recommend relevant solutions across payments, FX, and risk management. Build relationships and influence stakeholders at different levels, from start-up founders and business owners through to directors, finance leaders, and C-suite executives. Introduce prospects to relevant internal specialists and support functions, ensuring clients receive the appropriate expertise throughout the sales process. Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM records, including sales activity, prospect status, next steps, and opportunity information. Conduct market analysis, monitor industry developments, and participate in relevant events to identify emerging opportunities and strengthen market knowledge. Requirements: 2–5+ years of experience in financial services, ideally within foreign exchange, international payments, commercial payments, or a related financial technology environment. Practical understanding of financial markets and instruments, including spot transactions, forwards, derivatives, FX, payments, risk management, and/or hedging solutions. Proven B2B sales experience with a track record of acquiring new customers and achieving or exceeding revenue and performance targets. Experience with consultative selling, corporate negotiations, prospecting, networking events, trade fairs, cold calling, and other proactive business development activities. Strong understanding of international and bulk payment processing, accounting systems, payment technologies, and platform integrations. Financially astute, commercially minded, and comfortable translating complex financial or payment concepts into clear business value for customers. Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence senior decision-makers. Self-motivated and comfortable working independently while also collaborating effectively

southparkcommons-junior-ai:ashbyhq:344ab.title: Lead Designer
southparkcommons-junior-ai:ashbyhq:344ab.description: 👶 ABOUT JUNIOR We're building cutting-edge LLM-powered tools that supercharge investment research for the world's most demanding deal teams. Our clients include several of the top 10 global private equity firms, Big 4 professional services firms, and leading consulting practices: organisations responsible for deploying billions of dollars annually. We're a profitable, bootstrapped company with a growing team of 47 people based in London and New York. We 10x'd our revenue in 2025 and are on track to grow 2-3x again this year. Junior saves clients an average of 10 hours per week, and we're expanding fast into new verticals including investment banking, hedge funds, and research firms. 👥 OUR USERS Junior’s users are consulting and private equity professionals at global strategy firms, boutique M&A shops, and independent investment teams—overworked, time‑poor, and highly intelligent. They spend far too much of their day on administrative busywork instead of the high‑impact analysis they were hired to do: juggling dozens of research and diligence calls, wrestling with messy transcripts, hunting down the right quotes, tracking entities across projects, and manually plugging insights into decks—all under brutal deadlines. Junior cuts through that friction by automating call ingestion, transcript cleanup, quote extraction, and insight structuring so they can focus on deep problem‑solving, deal sourcing, and crafting the recommendations that move the needle. 💡 THE ROLE As our fifth Product Designer, you'll have the unique opportunity to: - Ship quickly & work alongside our team of 3 designers - Design and build new modes of working with computers - Work on groundbreaking projects involving LLMs - Collaborate closely with our external partners to fuel our growth - Contribute to product decisions, direction and prioritization 🔧 SAMPLE SET OF PROJECTS - First of a kind human-in-the-loop UI design elements to guide LLMs - AI-driven, auto-filled, hypothesis tracker for investment research - Design & build a mobile app from scratch in 3 weeks - Real-time collaboration tools for consultants and investors 🔥 ABOUT YOU We're looking for a product-minded designer who: - Has exceptional taste and design judgement - Strong product sensibilities - Is based in NYC — we have a huge bias for IRL work - Has experience leading projects end-to-end and taking ideas from conception to execution independently - Is opinionated about their work and eager to contribute to product decisions - Has strong communication skills and a desire for a client-facing role — as a small team, we expect that everyone will be working closely with our external partners - Loves collaborating with engineers—we have a lot more of them than designers - Is curious about AI tools and how they might speed up design-to-code cycles. We love experimentation and encourage it at every level 🌵 BENEFITS All the usual benefits (competitive pay and equity, private healthcare etc). Unusual benefits: - Gym membership - In-office cook - Summers working in Greece by the beach 📩 HOW TO APPLY If you're excited about the opportunity to drive innovation at Junior, we'd love to hear from you! Email us at careers@myjunior.ai with your resume and a brief introduction. Please include: 1. Your portfolio 2. Your resume 3. One thing you would change about our brand. We can't wait to meet you! 🙌
